project.description: AI generated employee management application with HR, leave, role management and notifications.

features.name: User Authentication & JWT Login
features.description: Secure login interface with JWT access token generation and role-based access control.

features.name: Employee CRUD Operations
features.description: Create, view, update, and deactivate employee records with salary, department, and contact details.

features.name: Department Management
features.description: Manage company departments, budget allocation, and department head assignments.

features.name: Role & Access Control Management
features.description: Configure system roles (Admin, HR Manager, Employee) and granular permissions.

features.name: Leave Management & Approval Workflow
features.description: Employee leave request submission, leave balance tracking, and manager approval workflow.

features.name: Executive Dashboard
features.description: Visual dashboard summarizing total employees, active leaves, department headcounts, and payroll metrics.

features.name: Real-time System Notifications
features.description: Notification center for leave approvals, policy updates, and system announcements.

user_stories.title: Employee Authentication & Role Login
acceptance_criteria: System validates credentials and returns JWT bearer token
Redirects to Executive Dashboard on success

user_stories.title: Employee Record CRUD & Profile View
acceptance_criteria: HR can search and filter employees
Modal dialog to add new employee
API endpoint updates employee details in PostgreSQL

user_stories.title: Leave Request Submission & Manager Approval
acceptance_criteria: Employee chooses leave type and date range
System updates leave balance upon approval

wireframe.layout: Sidebar Navigation with Header and Main Workspace Content Area

screens.name: Executive Dashboard
elements: Header Stat Cards (Total Employees, Active Leaves, Departments)
